title: Separate streaming parser, chunk normalization, and unsupported streaming strategy
description: OpenAI-compatible chat and MiniMax TTS already parse SSE-like streams locally, while core/pipeline have a separate MessageStream delivery boundary. Extract stream parsing and strategy policy before adding provider/tool streaming and AstrBot unsupported_streaming_strategy parity.

files.change: Move event splitting, JSON delta extraction, and malformed-stream errors out of concrete providers.
Keep only transport-neutral MessageStream semantics in core.

criteria: Provider adapters do not own generic SSE splitting or chunk normalization.
Unsupported streaming behavior is represented as explicit policy, not adapter-local string errors.
RespondStage remains a delivery boundary and does not parse provider streams.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test --workspace
